question: How much do three predefined fixed-nf coupling prescriptions change the two collinear partial moments at the same literal printed parameters? No refit, model selection or historical prescription admission.

definition.quantity: unweighted h1^q under the unchanged forward LO transversity kernel
definition.inputs: same strict pinned CT10 and DSSV08 Soffer inputs for all models at each shared grid

prepared_time_interface.meaning: tau(Q2,Q02) = integral alpha_s/(2*pi) d ln Q2, supplied as fixed external numerical settings
prepared_time_interface.ownership: immutable owned tuples, nonempty bounded source and model identifiers and a 64-character lowercase SHA256 provenance link
prepared_time_interface.labels: 1 to 4096 strictly increasing positive Q2 values including exact Q02 at exact zero tau; finite strictly increasing tau with abs(tau)<=1
prepared_time_interface.queries: exact scale and nf matching only; query reorder and repeats allowed; no interpolation, extrapolation, settings AD or alpha_s reconstruction
prepared_time_interface.native: unchanged retained LO bridge and auxiliary-time mapping; preserve the original signature and defaults for existing constructors; bind new profile identity in snapshots
prepared_time_interface.dense: unchanged generator and exp(tau*P); new prepared branch binds complete grid, matrix, settings and profile identity
prepared_time_interface.excluded: point-row and Wilson-matching adapters must reject prepared profiles until their physical-alpha and identity contract is separately implemented

receipt_policy.coupling: fresh HOPPET-COUPLING-DIAGNOSTIC-001 receipt from current sources and current verified build; all 36 named checks recomputed under its unchanged policy; complete native request/stdout/stderr hashes and selected native times rechecked against stored quadrature and independent 256-bit beta roots
receipt_policy.analytic: fresh PREPARED-EVOLUTION-TIMES-001 analytic/native controls on current sources and the same build; incomplete, failed, absent or stale receipts reject physical execution
receipt_policy.cross_model_inputs: exact shared grids, initial parameters and Soffer/initial arrays at each resolution; coupling profile is the sole changed input
receipt_policy.sources: all numerical Julia sources, relevant contracts, drivers, reference helpers and compiled-adapter input sources bound by exact file hashes

analytic_policy.derivative_reference: independent analytic polynomial coefficient derivatives; fixed prepared times and grid; no differentiation of U settings
analytic_policy.negative_controls: owned immutable inputs, malformed scales/times/identity, unavailable scale, mismatched nf/Q02, settings AD, altered source identity, mutated grid/time/matrix, point and matching API rejection

numerical_policy.refinement_rule: Evaluate first three shared resolutions on each ladder for all models. Extend each ladder within its frozen budget while any model's last pair or any native/dense comparison fails. Retain all coarse trials.
numerical_policy.moment_integration: exact piecewise-linear x-cell integral, clipped to the same requested measured-x window
numerical_policy.independent_integration: QuadGK in log x split at all dense knots including dx=x*dlog(x)

parameter_derivatives.coordinates: all 13 physical coordinates; seven Collins-only derivatives are zero for these h1 moments
parameter_derivatives.boundary: Nh_d=-1 uses inward forward differences; do not cross or move the closed physical boundary
parameter_derivatives.method: 256-bit independent direct-power initial formula with fixed native moment functional; second-order one-sided JVP and HVP of its analytic gradient
